notes: The abstract states: "The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 62.5% compared with 37.5% in the placebo group". It reports 32 PCOS women recruited and equally allocated to the two groups, but does not print either arm denominator or event count; none were calculated. Both arms received clomifene citrate. Ovulation assessment was on the 7th, 11th and 13th day of the cycle. Whether the reported rates represent participants or cycles and their precise end-of-treatment analysis window are NOT_IN_PACKET.
